// ContractOptional preserves absent versus explicit null. The Go 1.27 encoder's
// omitzero checks IsZero; an explicit null requires a nullable schema/value type.
type FixtureContractOptional[T any] struct {
	Value   T
	Present bool
}

func (f FixtureContractOptional[T]) IsZero() bool                 { return !f.Present }
func (f FixtureContractOptional[T]) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) { return json.Marshal(f.Value) }
func (f *FixtureContractOptional[T]) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	var v T
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &v); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	f.Value = v
	f.Present = true
	return nil
}

		panic("invalid generated schema")

}()

// Reject duplicate names and trailing JSON before decoding into DTOs. Numeric
// tokens remain json.Number; money and revisions are never converted to floats.
func fixtureContractRead(data []byte) (any, error) {
	if !utf8.Valid(data) || !fixtureContractUnicode(data) {
		return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	d.UseNumber()
	var walk func() (any, error)
	walk = func() (any, error) {
		token, err := d.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		delim, ok := token.(json.Delim)
		if !ok {
			if n, ok := token.(json.Number); ok {
				r, ok := new(big.Rat).SetString(string(n))
				if !ok || !r.IsInt() || !r.Num().IsInt64() || math.Abs(float64(r.Num().Int64())) > 9007199254740991 {
					return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
				}
				return json.Number(r.Num().String()), nil
			}
			return token, nil
		}
		switch delim {
		case '{':
			v := map[string]any{}
			for d.More() {
				key, err := d.Token()
				if err != nil {
					return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
				}
				name, ok := key.(string)
				if !ok {
					return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
				}
				if _, ok = v[name]; ok {
					return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
				}
				item, err := walk()
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				v[name] = item
			}
			if end, err := d.Token(); err != nil || end != json.Delim('}') {
				return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
			}
			return v, nil
		case '[':
			v := []any{}
			for d.More() {
				item, err := walk()
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				v = append(v, item)
			}
			if end, err := d.Token(); err != nil || end != json.Delim(']') {
				return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
			}
			return v, nil
		}
		return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	v, err := walk()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err = d.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	return v, nil
}
func fixtureContractUnicode(data []byte) bool {
	for i := 0; i < len(data); i++ {
		if data[i] != '\\' {
			continue
		}
		i++
		if i >= len(data) {
			return false
		}
		if data[i] != 'u' {
			continue
		}
		if i+4 >= len(data) {
			return false
		}
		code, err := strconv.ParseUint(string(data[i+1:i+5]), 16, 16)
		if err != nil {
			return false
		}
		i += 4
		if code >= 0xdc00 && code <= 0xdfff {
			return false
		}
		if code >= 0xd800 && code <= 0xdbff {
			if i+6 >= len(data) || data[i+1] != '\\' || data[i+2] != 'u' {
				return false
			}
			low, err := strconv.ParseUint(string(data[i+3:i+7]), 16, 16)
			if err != nil || low < 0xdc00 || low > 0xdfff {
				return false
			}
			i += 6
		}
	}
	return true
}
func fixtureContractDecode(data []byte, target any) error {
	value, err := fixtureContractRead(data)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	normalized, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	return json.Unmarshal(normalized, target)
}
func fixtureContractEqual(a, b any) bool {
	x, xe := json.Marshal(a)
	y, ye := json.Marshal(b)
	return xe == nil && ye == nil && bytes.Equal(x, y)
}
func fixtureContractValidate(s map[string]any, v any) error {
	if ref, ok := s["$ref"].(string); ok {
		name := ref[strings.LastIndex(ref, "/")+1:]
		next, ok := fixtureContractSchemas[name]
		if !ok {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		return fixtureContractValidate(next, v)
	}
	if variants, ok := s["oneOf"].([]any); ok {
		count := 0
		for _, variant := range variants {
			if fixtureContractValidate(variant.(map[string]any), v) == nil {
				count++
			}
		}
		if count != 1 {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		return nil
	}
	if expected, ok := s["const"]; ok && !fixtureContractEqual(expected, v) {
		return fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	if choices, ok := s["enum"].([]any); ok {
		found := false
		for _, choice := range choices {
			found = found || fixtureContractEqual(choice, v)
		}
		if !found {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
	}
	typ, ok := s["type"].(string)
	allowsNull := typ == "null"
	if !ok {
		for _, candidate := range s["type"].([]any) {
			if candidate == "null" {
				allowsNull = true
			} else {
				typ = candidate.(string)
			}
		}
	}
	if v == nil {
		if allowsNull {
			return nil
		}
		return fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	bound := func(key string, n int, lower bool) bool {
		limit, ok := s[key].(float64)
		return !ok || lower && float64(n) >= limit || !lower && float64(n) <= limit
	}
	switch typ {
	case "string":
		value, ok := v.(string)
		if !ok || !utf8.ValidString(value) || !bound("minLength", utf8.RuneCountInString(value), true) || !bound("maxLength", utf8.RuneCountInString(value), false) {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		if pattern, ok := s["pattern"].(string); ok {
			// No multiline flag is enabled in either runtime. Standard '$' therefore
			// rejects final line terminators in both. Translate only the explicit
			// standard ECMAScript end-of-input suffix, unsupported by RE2 itself.
			if strings.HasSuffix(pattern, "(?![\\s\\S])") {
				pattern = strings.TrimSuffix(pattern, "(?![\\s\\S])") + "\\z"
			}
			re, err := regexp.Compile(pattern)
			if err != nil || !re.MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractInvalid
			}
		}
		switch s["format"] {
		case "uuid":
			if !regexp.MustCompile("^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$").MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractInvalid
			}
		case "date":
			if !regexp.MustCompile("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$").MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractInvalid
			}
			if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value); err != nil {
				return fixtureContractInvalid
			}
		case "date-time":
			if !regexp.MustCompile("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?:\\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$").MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractInvalid
			}
			if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value); err != nil {
				return fixtureContractInvalid
			}
		}
	case "integer":
		n, ok := v.(json.Number)
		if !ok {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(n), 64)
		if err != nil || math.Trunc(value) != value || math.Abs(value) > 9007199254740991 || value < s["minimum"].(float64) || value > s["maximum"].(float64) {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
	case "boolean":
		if _, ok := v.(bool); !ok {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
	case "array":
		values, ok := v.([]any)
		if !ok || !bound("minItems", len(values), true) || !bound("maxItems", len(values), false) {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, item := range values {
			if err := fixtureContractValidate(s["items"].(map[string]any), item); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if s["uniqueItems"] == true {
				raw, _ := json.Marshal(item)
				if seen[string(raw)] {
					return fixtureContractInvalid
				}
				seen[string(raw)] = true
			}
		}
	case "object":
		values, ok := v.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		if s["additionalProperties"] == false {
			props := s["properties"].(map[string]any)
			if required, ok := s["required"].([]any); ok {
				for _, key := range required {
					if _, ok := values[key.(string)]; !ok {
						return fixtureContractInvalid
					}
				}
			}
			for key, item := range values {
				prop, ok := props[key]
				if !ok {
					return fixtureContractInvalid
				}
				if err := fixtureContractValidate(prop.(map[string]any), item); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		} else {
			for _, item := range values {
				if err := fixtureContractValidate(s["additionalProperties"].(map[string]any), item); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
	default:
		return fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	return nil
}
func fixtureContractCheck(name string, data []byte) error {
	value, err := fixtureContractRead(data)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return fixtureContractValidate(fixtureContractSchemas[name], value)
}

func (v FixtureAmbiguous) MarshalJSON() ([]byte, error) {
	count := 0
	var value any
	if v.Variant1 != nil {
		count++
		value = v.Variant1
	}
	if v.Variant2 != nil {
		count++
		value = v.Variant2
	}
	if count != 1 {
		return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	if err = fixtureContractCheck("Ambiguous", data); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return data, nil
}
func (v *FixtureAmbiguous) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {

		return err

	var next FixtureAmbiguous
	if fixtureContractCheck("Leaf", data) == nil {
		var item FixtureLeaf
		if err := fixtureContractDecode(data, &item); err != nil {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		next.Variant1 = &item

	if fixtureContractCheck("Twin", data) == nil {
		var item FixtureTwin
		if err := fixtureContractDecode(data, &item); err != nil {
			return fixtureContractInvalid
		}
		next.Variant2 = &item
	}
	*v = next
	return nil
}

		count++

}

	return data, nil
}
func (v *FixtureEnvelope) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {
	if err := fixtureContractCheck("Envelope", data); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	type alias FixtureEnvelope
	var next alias
	if err := fixtureContractDecode(data, &next); err != nil {
		return fixtureContractInvalid
	}
	*v = FixtureEnvelope(next)
	return nil
}

type FixtureSemanticOutcome uint8

const (
	FixtureSemanticValid              FixtureSemanticOutcome = 1
	FixtureSemanticMismatch           FixtureSemanticOutcome = 2
	FixtureSemanticFatalPolicy        FixtureSemanticOutcome = 3
	FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration FixtureSemanticOutcome = 4
	FixtureSemanticFatalBinding       FixtureSemanticOutcome = 5
)

type FixtureAuthErrorResponse struct {
	Variant1 *FixtureOtherProblem
	Variant2 *FixtureProblem
}
type FixtureAuthSemantics interface {
	CheckReady() FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAlias(FixtureAlias) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAmbiguous(FixtureAmbiguous) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation0Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation0Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation1Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation1Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation2Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation2Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation3Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation3Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation4Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation4Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation5Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation5Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation6Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation6Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation7Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation7Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation8Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation8Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateAuthOperation9Parameters(FixtureAuthOperation9Parameters) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateChoice(FixtureChoice) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateEnvelope(FixtureEnvelope) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateLeaf(FixtureLeaf) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateLeft(FixtureLeft) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateMaybe(FixtureMaybe) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateOther(FixtureOther) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateOtherProblem(FixtureOtherProblem) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateProblem(FixtureProblem) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateRight(FixtureRight) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateTwin(FixtureTwin) FixtureSemanticOutcome
	ValidateError(string, int, FixtureAuthErrorResponse) FixtureSemanticOutcome
}
type FixtureAuthValidators struct {
	readiness func() FixtureSemanticOutcome
	builders  map[string]func(any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error)
	errorHook func(string, int, FixtureAuthErrorResponse) FixtureSemanticOutcome
}

func FixtureNewAuthValidators(binding FixtureAuthSemantics) (*FixtureAuthValidators, error) {
	if binding == nil {
		return nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalBinding}
	}
	value := reflect.ValueOf(binding)
	switch value.Kind() {
	case reflect.Chan, reflect.Func, reflect.Interface, reflect.Map, reflect.Pointer, reflect.Slice:
		if value.IsNil() {
			return nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalBinding}
		}
	}
	v := &FixtureAuthValidators{readiness: binding.CheckReady, errorHook: binding.ValidateError, builders: map[string]func(any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error){}}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAlias
		v.builders["Alias"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAlias
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAmbiguous
		v.builders["Ambiguous"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAmbiguous
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation0Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation0Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation0Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation1Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation1Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation1Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation2Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation2Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation2Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation3Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation3Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation3Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation4Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation4Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation4Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation5Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation5Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation5Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation6Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation6Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation6Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation7Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation7Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation7Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation8Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation8Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation8Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateAuthOperation9Parameters
		v.builders["AuthOperation9Parameters"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureAuthOperation9Parameters
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err

			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateChoice
		v.builders["Choice"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureChoice
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateEnvelope
		v.builders["Envelope"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureEnvelope
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err

			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateLeaf
		v.builders["Leaf"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureLeaf
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err

			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err

		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateOther
		v.builders["Other"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureOther
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateOtherProblem
		v.builders["OtherProblem"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureOtherProblem
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateProblem
		v.builders["Problem"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureProblem
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateRight
		v.builders["Right"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureRight
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	{
		hook := binding.ValidateTwin
		v.builders["Twin"] = func(raw any) (func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, error) {
			var value FixtureTwin
			if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			return func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return hook(value) }, nil
		}
	}
	if err := v.ready(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return v, nil
}

var fixtureContractAuthErrorSchemas = map[string]map[int]string{"AuthOperation0": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation1": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation4": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation2": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation6": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation7": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation3": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation9": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation8": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}, "AuthOperation5": {401: "Problem", 403: "Problem", 429: "OtherProblem"}}

type FixtureAuthValidationError struct{ Outcome FixtureSemanticOutcome }

func (e FixtureAuthValidationError) Error() string { return "invalid auth validation" }

var fixtureContractAuthMismatch = errors.New("structural mismatch")
var fixtureContractAuthConfiguration = errors.New("structural configuration")

type fixtureContractAuthOccurrence struct {
	name  string
	value any
}

var fixtureContractAuthExpectedSchemas = func() []byte {
	data, err := json.Marshal(fixtureContractSchemas)
	if err != nil {
		panic("invalid generated configuration")
	}
	return data
}()

func fixtureContractAuthKeys(values map[string]any) []string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for key := range values {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	return keys
}
func fixtureContractAuthInvoke(hook func() FixtureSemanticOutcome) (outcome FixtureSemanticOutcome) {
	outcome = FixtureSemanticFatalBinding
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			outcome = FixtureSemanticFatalBinding
		}
	}()
	outcome = hook()
	switch outcome {
	case FixtureSemanticValid, FixtureSemanticMismatch, FixtureSemanticFatalPolicy, FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration, FixtureSemanticFatalBinding:
		return outcome
	}
	return FixtureSemanticFatalBinding
}
func fixtureContractAuthRequire(outcome FixtureSemanticOutcome) error {
	if outcome != FixtureSemanticValid {
		return FixtureAuthValidationError{outcome}
	}
	return nil
}
func (v *FixtureAuthValidators) ready() error {
	if v == nil || v.readiness == nil {
		return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalBinding}
	}
	outcome := fixtureContractAuthInvoke(v.readiness)
	if outcome == FixtureSemanticMismatch {
		outcome = FixtureSemanticFatalBinding
	}
	return fixtureContractAuthRequire(outcome)
}
func fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw any, target any) (err error) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			err = FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
		}
	}()
	data, err := json.Marshal(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
	}
	if err = json.Unmarshal(data, target); err != nil {
		return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
	}
	return nil
}
func (v *FixtureAuthValidators) prepare(name string, data []byte) (raw any, hooks []func() FixtureSemanticOutcome, err error) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			raw = nil
			hooks = nil
			err = FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
		}
	}()
	current, err := json.Marshal(fixtureContractSchemas)
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(current, fixtureContractAuthExpectedSchemas) {
		return nil, nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
	}
	schema, ok := fixtureContractSchemas[name]
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
	}
	raw, err = fixtureContractRead(data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticMismatch}
	}
	var visits []fixtureContractAuthOccurrence
	if err = fixtureContractAuthStructural(schema, raw, &visits); err != nil {
		if err == fixtureContractAuthMismatch {
			return nil, nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticMismatch}
		}
		return nil, nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
	}
	visits = append(visits, fixtureContractAuthOccurrence{name, raw})
	for _, visit := range visits {
		builder, ok := v.builders[visit.name]
		if !ok {
			return nil, nil, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalBinding}
		}
		hook, err := builder(visit.value)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
		hooks = append(hooks, hook)
	}
	return raw, hooks, nil
}
func (v *FixtureAuthValidators) run(hooks []func() FixtureSemanticOutcome) error {
	for _, hook := range hooks {
		if err := v.ready(); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := fixtureContractAuthRequire(fixtureContractAuthInvoke(hook)); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}
func fixtureContractAuthUTF8(value reflect.Value) bool {
	if !value.IsValid() {
		return true
	}
	switch value.Kind() {
	case reflect.String:
		return utf8.ValidString(value.String())
	case reflect.Pointer, reflect.Interface:
		if !value.IsNil() {
			return fixtureContractAuthUTF8(value.Elem())
		}
	case reflect.Struct:
		for i := 0; i < value.NumField(); i++ {
			if !fixtureContractAuthUTF8(value.Field(i)) {
				return false
			}
		}
	case reflect.Array, reflect.Slice:
		for i := 0; i < value.Len(); i++ {
			if !fixtureContractAuthUTF8(value.Index(i)) {
				return false
			}
		}
	case reflect.Map:
		for _, key := range value.MapKeys() {
			if !fixtureContractAuthUTF8(key) || !fixtureContractAuthUTF8(value.MapIndex(key)) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}
func fixtureContractAuthStructural(s map[string]any, v any, visits *[]fixtureContractAuthOccurrence) error {
	if ref, ok := s["$ref"].(string); ok {
		name := ref[strings.LastIndex(ref, "/")+1:]
		next, ok := fixtureContractSchemas[name]
		if !ok {
			return fixtureContractAuthConfiguration
		}
		if err := fixtureContractAuthStructural(next, v, visits); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		*visits = append(*visits, fixtureContractAuthOccurrence{name, v})
		return nil
	}
	if variants, ok := s["oneOf"].([]any); ok {
		count := 0
		var selected []fixtureContractAuthOccurrence
		for _, variant := range variants {
			var candidate []fixtureContractAuthOccurrence
			err := fixtureContractAuthStructural(variant.(map[string]any), v, &candidate)
			if err == nil {
				count++
				selected = candidate
			} else if err != fixtureContractAuthMismatch {
				return err
			}
		}
		if count != 1 {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
		*visits = append(*visits, selected...)
		return nil
	}
	if expected, ok := s["const"]; ok && !fixtureContractEqual(expected, v) {
		return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
	}
	if choices, ok := s["enum"].([]any); ok {
		found := false
		for _, choice := range choices {
			found = found || fixtureContractEqual(choice, v)
		}
		if !found {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
	}
	typ, ok := s["type"].(string)
	allowsNull := typ == "null"
	if !ok {
		for _, candidate := range s["type"].([]any) {
			if candidate == "null" {
				allowsNull = true
			} else {
				typ = candidate.(string)
			}
		}
	}
	if v == nil {
		if allowsNull {
			return nil
		}
		return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
	}
	bound := func(key string, n int, lower bool) bool {
		limit, ok := s[key].(float64)
		return !ok || lower && float64(n) >= limit || !lower && float64(n) <= limit
	}
	switch typ {
	case "string":
		value, ok := v.(string)
		if !ok || !utf8.ValidString(value) || !bound("minLength", utf8.RuneCountInString(value), true) || !bound("maxLength", utf8.RuneCountInString(value), false) {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
		if pattern, ok := s["pattern"].(string); ok {
			// No multiline flag is enabled in either runtime. Standard '$' therefore
			// rejects final line terminators in both. Translate only the explicit
			// standard ECMAScript end-of-input suffix, unsupported by RE2 itself.
			if strings.HasSuffix(pattern, "(?![\\s\\S])") {
				pattern = strings.TrimSuffix(pattern, "(?![\\s\\S])") + "\\z"
			}
			re, err := regexp.Compile(pattern)
			if err != nil {
				return fixtureContractAuthConfiguration
			}
			if !re.MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
			}
		}
		switch s["format"] {
		case "uuid":
			if !regexp.MustCompile("^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$").MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
			}
		case "date":
			if !regexp.MustCompile("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$").MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
			}
			if _, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", value); err != nil {
				return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
			}
		case "date-time":
			if !regexp.MustCompile("^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}(?:\\.[0-9]{1,9})?Z$").MatchString(value) {
				return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
			}
			if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, value); err != nil {
				return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
			}
		}
	case "integer":
		n, ok := v.(json.Number)
		if !ok {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
		value, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(n), 64)
		if err != nil || math.Trunc(value) != value || math.Abs(value) > 9007199254740991 || value < s["minimum"].(float64) || value > s["maximum"].(float64) {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
	case "boolean":
		if _, ok := v.(bool); !ok {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
	case "array":
		values, ok := v.([]any)
		if !ok || !bound("minItems", len(values), true) || !bound("maxItems", len(values), false) {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, item := range values {
			if err := fixtureContractAuthStructural(s["items"].(map[string]any), item, visits); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if s["uniqueItems"] == true {
				raw, _ := json.Marshal(item)
				if seen[string(raw)] {
					return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
				}
				seen[string(raw)] = true
			}
		}
	case "object":
		values, ok := v.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
		}
		if s["additionalProperties"] == false {
			props := s["properties"].(map[string]any)
			if required, ok := s["required"].([]any); ok {
				for _, key := range required {
					if _, ok := values[key.(string)]; !ok {
						return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
					}
				}
			}
			for _, key := range fixtureContractAuthKeys(values) {
				item := values[key]
				prop, ok := props[key]
				if !ok {
					return fixtureContractAuthMismatch
				}
				if err := fixtureContractAuthStructural(prop.(map[string]any), item, visits); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		} else {
			for _, key := range fixtureContractAuthKeys(values) {
				item := values[key]
				if err := fixtureContractAuthStructural(s["additionalProperties"].(map[string]any), item, visits); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
	default:
		return fixtureContractAuthConfiguration
	}
	return nil
}
func (v *FixtureAuthValidators) ParseAlias(data []byte) (FixtureAlias, error) {
	var value FixtureAlias
	if err := v.ready(); err != nil {
		return value, err
	}
	raw, hooks, err := v.prepare("Alias", data)
	if err != nil {
		return value, err
	}
	if err = fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
		return value, err
	}
	if err = v.run(hooks); err != nil {
		var empty FixtureAlias
		return empty, err
	}
	return value, nil
}

func fixtureContractAuthErrorName(operation string, status int) (string, error) {
	name, ok := fixtureContractAuthErrorSchemas[operation][status]
	if !ok {
		return "", FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
	}
	return name, nil
}
func fixtureContractAuthErrorValue(name string, raw any) (FixtureAuthErrorResponse, error) {
	var result FixtureAuthErrorResponse
	switch name {
	case "OtherProblem":
		var value FixtureOtherProblem
		if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
		result.Variant1 = &value
		return result, nil
	case "Problem":
		var value FixtureProblem
		if err := fixtureContractAuthDecode(raw, &value); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
		result.Variant2 = &value
		return result, nil
	}
	return result, FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
}
func (v *FixtureAuthValidators) parseError(operation string, status int, data []byte) (FixtureAuthErrorResponse, error) {
	var empty FixtureAuthErrorResponse
	name, err := fixtureContractAuthErrorName(operation, status)
	if err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	raw, hooks, err := v.prepare(name, data)
	if err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	value, err := fixtureContractAuthErrorValue(name, raw)
	if err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	if err = v.run(hooks); err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	if err = v.ready(); err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	if err = fixtureContractAuthRequire(fixtureContractAuthInvoke(func() FixtureSemanticOutcome { return v.errorHook(operation, status, value) })); err != nil {
		return empty, err
	}
	return value, nil
}
func (v *FixtureAuthValidators) ParseError(operation string, status int, data []byte) (FixtureAuthErrorResponse, error) {
	if err := v.ready(); err != nil {
		var empty FixtureAuthErrorResponse
		return empty, err
	}
	return v.parseError(operation, status, data)
}
func (v *FixtureAuthValidators) ValidateError(operation string, status int, value FixtureAuthErrorResponse) (err error) {
	defer func() {
		if recover() != nil {
			err = FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticFatalConfiguration}
		}
	}()
	if err = v.ready(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	name, err := fixtureContractAuthErrorName(operation, status)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var selected any
	count := 0
	if value.Variant1 != nil {
		count++
		if name != "OtherProblem" {
			return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticMismatch}
		}
		selected = value.Variant1
	}
	if value.Variant2 != nil {
		count++
		if name != "Problem" {
			return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticMismatch}
		}
		selected = value.Variant2
	}
	if count != 1 {
		return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticMismatch}
	}
	if !fixtureContractAuthUTF8(reflect.ValueOf(selected)) {
		return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticMismatch}
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(selected)
	if err != nil {
		return FixtureAuthValidationError{FixtureSemanticMismatch}
	}
	_, err = v.parseError(operation, status, data)
	return err
}
